notes.title: Thank You for Playing the Demo!
notes.notes: [p]Third-Person Shooter Fest has come to an end, and we’ve brought the Last Flag demo offline. Getting the chance to put this early version of our game into the hands of so many new players has been incredible. We’ve had a blast playing with and against you in “Beat the Devs” matches this week, watching your streams and videos, admiring your cosplays and artwork, and chatting with you about the game during daily Q&A sessions.[/p][p]Most of all, we’re grateful to everyone for trying out Last Flag and sharing feedback with us. We’re still reading through everything the community written so far, and we’ve got lots to discuss as we look to make improvements based on your thoughts. We’re excited to see what you think as we return to private playtesting and roll out new updates over the coming months.[/p][p][/p][h2]Closed Playtests Return[/h2][p]As much fun as it has been tuning in to your channels to watch you play the game this week, playtesters’ Non-Disclosure Agreements go back into effect today. Anything you recorded up until now can still be shared, and anything you’ve already posted can remain publicly visible.[/p][p]However, [b]please do not stream, post videos or screenshots, or share game information from any new playtests after September 1, 2025[/b]. Future playtests will include unreleased game content, and we would like to keep it a surprise for as many players as possible.[/p][p][/p][h2]Sign Up to Continue Playtesting[/h2][p]As mentioned above, we’re returning to closed playtesting this week. If you couldn’t get enough of the Last Flag demo while it was live, we’ve got good news: You can continue to join future playtest sessions throughout development by [url="https://lastflag.com/"]signing up on the official Last Flag website[/url]. We plan to continue sending out invites regularly, so make sure to grab your spot on the waiting list now.[/p][p]You can also catch the latest news by [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2721340?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=article&utm_campaign=demoaug2025"]following and wishlisting Last Flag[/url] on Steam. Your follows and wishlists help a great deal with visibility on the platform, and we appreciate every single one. Thank you again for playing the Last Flag alpha during our demo this week. We can’t wait to show you what we’re cooking up next.[/p]

notes.title: Join Community Activities All Week Long!
notes.notes:
[p]We’ve been over the moon to share an early look at the Last Flag alpha with so many new players in our Third Person Shooter Fest demo this week. To celebrate the growing Last Flag community, and this huge moment for the game, we’re hosting special events for you all week long.[/p][p]Read on to learn how you can take part in daily Dev Q&A sessions, go head-to-head with our dev team in-game, play Last Flag Bingo, and enter giveaways by sharing your creations with us.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Daily Dev Q&A Sessions[/h2][p]Ever wonder what goes into designing an environment? Interested in the transformation of a character from concept art to final model? Or maybe you’re after tips on how to break into the games industry? Good news! We’ve got [b]Dev Q&A sessions lined up every day this week[/b] covering all those topics, and more.

Team members from across Night Street will be on hand in the [url="https://discord.gg/lastflag"]official Last Flag Discord server[/url] to share details about how they’re bringing Last Flag to life, and answering your questions in real time. Check out our community event calendar below to catch the dates and times for upcoming Dev Q&As this week.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649313/4d7eadec990806de11a2dbd5361dc2c177c6ed49.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Beat the Devs, Claim a Discord Role[/h2][p]Think you can take down the devs? Immediately following every Q&A session, the Night Street team will be heading into the Quickmatch queue to challenge you to beat them at their own game. If you manage to win a match against a dev, grab a screenshot of the post-match scoreboard and share it with us in the Last Flag Discord server. You’ll earn bragging rights [i]and[/i] the [b]exclusive “Dev Destroyer” role.[/b]

[b]Note:[/b] Devs will have "\[NS]" in their in-game names.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Show Us Your Art and Cosplays[/h2][p]We love seeing your creativity—so let’s see what you can come up with for Last Flag’s contestants! Submit your character-themed Last Flag art to us by tagging “@playlastflag” on social media, or by posting in the Last Flag Discord server for a [b]chance to win a $50 gift card.[/b]

Not feeling particularly artistic? That’s OK! Raid your wardrobe to put together your best “closet cosplay” of a Last Flag contestant. Once again, you can submit a picture of your outfit to us by tagging “@playlastflag” on socials, or by visiting the [url="https://discord.gg/lastflag"]Last Flag Discord server[/url], for [b]another chance[/b] to win a $50 gift card.

Three winners each from the art and cosplay categories will be chosen at random. Just make sure to send in your submissions [b]before 10:00 a.m. PDT (1:00 p.m. EDT / 19:00 CEST) on September 1, 2025.[/b][/p][p] [/p][h2]Let’s Play Bingo — Last Flag Style![/h2][p]Finally, we’ve put together a uniquely Last Flag themed Bingo card that’s brimming with side quests for you to take on in-game. Head into your matches this week to complete the activities on the Bingo card below, and mark them as you go. Once you've scored a Bingo by marking five spaces in a row, you can post your card in ⁠the Last Flag Discord to snatch up the [b]exclusive “Bingo Master” server role.[/b] Better get started, you’ve got until September 1 to complete your card!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649313/38ae874fb8a3a974549391c0cc52a01c6f81cbce.png"][/img]

We have been having an absolute blast playing in matches with you, and we hope you enjoy some of these bonus activities we’ve put together during our demo week.
[/p]

notes.title: Steam Demo Live Now Until September 1!
notes.notes:
If you’ve been waiting to start swiping flags, now’s your chance. We just kicked off a limited-time demo that’s [b]open to everyone from August 25 – September 1[/b] as part of Steam’s Third-Person Shooter Fest!

Devastate opposing defenses with a blast from Alejandro’s Bunker Buster Bazooka, slice and dice your foes from the shadows as Soo-Jin, or teleport your problems away with Camila’s Quantum Entanglement Ray—download the demo now to join the fray and find a contestant that fits your playstyle.

If you’d like to find teammates, want to chat about the game, or you need a little troubleshooting help, the Last Flag community’s got your back. You can join the [url=https://discord.gg/lastflag]official Discord server here[/url].

[h2]Stream, Record & Post During the Demo[/h2]
Whether you’re a content creator, or you just want to share a clutch play with some friends, we’ve temporarily lifted our Non-Disclosure Agreement while the demo is available.

That means you’re free to livestream, record and post your gameplay, and discuss your Last Flag matches whenever and however you’d like, from now until September 1. If you’ve got a clip you’re particularly proud of, make sure to tag @playlastflag on your favorite social platform, because we’d love to see it too!

[h2]Sign Up to Continue Playtesting[/h2]
Once the demo concludes on September 1, Last Flag will re-enter closed playtesting. If you’d like to continue playing and sharing feedback with the Night Street team, you’ll need a playtesting invitation. Make sure you’ve signed up on the [url=https://lastflag.com/]official Last Flag website[/url] to secure your spot on our waiting list.

Thank you very much for checking out our game, we hope you have a blast capturing flags this week.

notes.title: Going Hands-On With Last Flag—One Mechanic, Several Ideas
notes.notes:
When I was presented with a preview opportunity for Last Flag, I’ll admit I was skeptical. Based on the initial pitch I had read, I wondered if a game based solely around “Capture the Flag” would have legs strong enough to support its weight. Look, I grew up playing Halo, and I love a good game of Capture the Flag as much as the next guy, but I didn’t think I’d play a game where that was the only game mode.

But once I sat down with the team at Night Street Games to get a little rundown of the game and play a couple of rounds, my opinion changed fast. “It’s capture the flag,” said Co-Founder and CEO of Night Street Games, Mac Reynolds. “It’s trying to kind of recreate that childhood experience of actual hiding and fighting in the forest, in a way that we got a taste of with some of our favourite CTF game modes, but never really saw evidence of a full Capture the Flag game.”

notes.title: Playtest Invites Have Begun!
notes.notes:
[p]Since our announcement at Summer Game Fest in June, the Night Street Games team has been working hard to get Last Flag ready to welcome in lots of new flag runners.[/p][p]Late last week, we kicked off a small initial round of alpha playtest invites, and now we’re ready to ramp things up. This week, we’ve sent out a much larger invite wave ahead of our next playtest on August 8.[/p][h3]
[b]Accept Your Invite and Grab Your Steam Key[/b][/h3][p]Be sure to check the email address you used to sign up for playtesting on the Last Flag website. If you were included in this round, there’s an invite email from our friends at FirstLook.gg waiting in your inbox. Click the “View Invite” button to begin the brief onboarding process. FirstLook will walk you through signing the Non-Disclosure Agreement, linking your Steam and Discord accounts, and then grant you a playtesting key to redeem on Steam.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Get Ready to Play(test)![/b][/h3][p]Once you’ve completed onboarding, you’re in! You can participate in any Last Flag playtests that fit your schedule between now and launch. [/p][p]Our next playtest will run from [b]Friday, August 8 at 10:00 a.m. PT (1:00 p.m. ET / 17:00 UTC) until 8:00 p.m. PT (11:00 p.m. ET / 03:00 UTC)[/b].[/p][p]We coordinate all playtesting in the Last Flag Discord server. For news about upcoming playtest dates and times, head into the server and keep an eye on the “#Next-Playtest” channel.[/p][h3]
[b]Sign Up Now to Join the Action[/b][/h3][p]Ready to catch an early look at Last Flag and share feedback that will help us shape the game during development? It’s not too late to sign up![/p][p]We’re planning to send out invite waves regularly between now and launch. Make sure to visit the [url="https://lastflag.com"]official Last Flag website[/url] and hit the “Sign Up” button to secure your place in line for private playtesting.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay on top of the latest game updates, get more chances to snatch an invite, and find others to party up with to go flag hunting, join the growing [url="https://discord.gg/lastflag"]Last Flag community on Discord[/url].[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who’s signed up for playtesting and tried the game so far, we are absolutely humbled by the number of players who are excited to give Last Flag a spin. We can’t wait to get your hands on the game and hear what you think.[/p]
